question: Which 超级会员 level does the 30-month 298 yuan card grant, and what is the cloud-drive high-speed download volume at that level?
why: The vendor page gives 2 TB per month at levels 1-3 and 12 TB at levels 7-10, while third-party articles state 10 TB; the level of a new card is not stated on the pages read, and the login page is unreadable.
